entities.name: The Walking Dead Secret Lair
entities.description: A Secret Lair drop tying in with The Walking Dead franchise, made of new cards and later part of Universes Beyond.

entities.name: Lucille
entities.description: A legendary artifact card, Negan's weapon of choice, included as the drop's bonus card.

entities.name: Walker
entities.description: The undead of The Walking Dead; a Walker token is a 2/2 black Zombie.

events.summary: The Walking Dead Secret Lair is offered for pre-order from October 4th through October 12th, 2020.
events.quote: It became available for pre-order purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com from October 4th through October 12th, 2020.

events.summary: The drop abandons the premise of Secret Lairs being only reprints with alternate art.
events.quote: With this drop, the premise of only reprints with alternate art for Secret Lairs was abandoned.

events.summary: The drop draws heavy fan criticism for featuring unique cards rather than reprints, but becomes the best-selling drop.
events.quote: the Walking Dead was the best selling drop, luring in buyers from outside of the Magic world.

relations.note: Replaced the usual bonus card as the drop's bonus.
relations.quote: It was replaced by a legendary artifact called Lucille ( Negan's weapon of choice) with art by Jason Felix.
